To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the best teaching is the best learning.
the best teaching practice is to teach across the eye.

the most important things to do as a teacher in the global higher education sector are to emphasize inquiry over information, to pay attention to the individual learner, and to practice the values of sympathetic intellectual humility and fairness.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of what is the best way to teach.
the question of what is the most effective way to teach in higher education.
the question: How can teachers in global higher education environments best teach the values of the liberal education tradition?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the most important thing to do in teaching is to teach.
the most valuable and secure thing that a teacher can do is to teach across the eye.
teachers should teach across the eye, and not just through it.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been trying to find ways to make the world a little better, and we are still trying.
we are all in the process of learning to see the world from the perspective of the other, and that the best way to teach is to learn to see the world as our students do.
the most important things to do are to teach across the eye of the learner, not to the eye, and to do so in the spirit of sympathetic understanding and humility.
The main takeaway from our work is that
teaching across the eye, in a way that respects the individuality of students and teachers, is a valuable way of responding to the insecurity of academic life in the global environment.
the values of the teacher are the most important part of teaching practice, and that these values can be cultivated and shared.
the most effective way to teach is to learn.
